trace.why: Photographed poster with passages filled in pale blue-grey to purple by depth, dark wall lines, soft focus. greyFill+blueWeight: darkness plus 2x blueness (a tan shadow along the walls' outer side is dark but not blue). Options not yet in trace_scan.py (prototyped in the session scratchpad mino_trace.py): fillOffInk (fill level averaged off the ink), inkTopHatPx (ink as thin strokes, so the purple deep fill isn't ink), paperOutside/notOutside/paperGapPx (paper level from the large areas outside the walls, never filled), inkBand (union with the default band of the drawn walls, for narrow stippled passages). Plain trace_scan.py ignores them and floods/loses passages.

symbols.why: Legend: overlined numbers are guideline depths in feet, circled numbers floor-to-ceiling distances in feet, p#### distances from the zero datum in feet (penetration), R minor / X major restriction, Z zero visibility, wavy arrows flow direction. OCR read 24 depths and 8 penetrations (one depth fixed: 25 -> 28); the other 51 depths, 20 penetrations, 125 circled heights, 53 letters and 27 flow arrows were found by a bar/ring/template search in a scratch script and each checked by eye on crops (extra). The scan is soft: a few blurred depths are uncertain (16/18/19 near J-J', 35 near J, 13 at the downstream end). The legend has no bones symbol and none is drawn (checked tile by tile). No 'To ...' leads; the three section names are place names at their titles.
